name: higgsfield-video
description: Turns a theme and an idea into a production-ready multi-shot video brief for Kling 3.0 on Higgsfield: fact-checks any real-world claims with sources, writes per-shot prompts that respect the Custom multi-shot limits (3 s minimum per shot, 5 shots, 15 s total, per-shot character budget with Element chips), assigns Elements and voices per shot, and emits a settings checklist plus a single-box Auto fallback. API generation is scaffolded for later.
